note: Wave C3. Quasi-static sub-horizon growth (Boisseau et al. 2000; Tsujikawa 2007) on the C2 background, massless limit inside the Compton length of psi (1/m is Gpc-scale for m/H0 of 1 to 3). Numbers from report() of uet_frw_growth.py on the T041 best point and six AI-chosen C2 points, each against LambdaCDM with the same Omega_m and early amplitude. Most of the suppression comes from the background (xi = 0 gives nearly the same numbers); the coupling changes G for clustering by at most 0.32% on allowed points. Not computed: transfer function, k dependence near the Compton scale, massive neutrinos, non-linear growth, sigma8 normalisation. Nearest theory: extended quintessence. Not UET-distinct. Prepares a growth Test Card (f sigma8 or S8) that would need data and the author's approval.
